expo.name: travi
expo.description: Collect the places you love. Find your next favorite with travi.

plugins.photosPermission: Travi uses photo locations to match landmarks and automatically upload new matching photos when you enable automatic collection. You can also attach photos manually.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Travi uses your location to detect landmark visits and show you on the globe. Location sharing is only with friends you choose.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Travi uses your location in the background for friend sharing and automatic landmark collection, only when you enable these features.

plugins.photosPermission: Travi uses photo locations to match landmarks and automatically upload new matching photos when you enable automatic collection. You can also attach photos manually.

plugins.contactsPermission: Travi checks your contacts' phone numbers to find friends already on Travi. Numbers are hashed on your device first.
